fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities analyst Evan Lee cut Dell Technologies (DELL) price target to $341 and maintains Hold rating; with stock down 45% from year-to-date high, meaningful upside appears absent.
fields.summary_ko.1: Dell faces headwinds from 9% decline expected in enterprise server shipments in fiscal 2027 and PC shipment slowdown, yet Wall Street consensus target of $587 suggests significant upside potential.
